name: agent-history-tool-turns-native
description: Native path: the SDK's real tool-call and role:'tool' result messages survive into the next user turn, so a second turn is sent the work itself. The fake path covers the same in agent-history-tool-turns; this one exercises the shapes a real provider would 400 on if they were persisted unpaired

turns.input: Create hello.txt with text hello from native.

expect.comment: inputMessageCount is one higher than the fixture's messageCount on this path: the native trace records options.prompt.length (system message included), while match.messageCount counts non-system messages only.
